Alif Laam Meem
Allah jis ke ilaawa koi khuda nahin hai, aur woh hamesha zinda hai aur har shai usi ke tufail mein qaaim hai
Us ne aap par woh barhaq kitaab naazil ki hai jo tamaam kitaabon ki tasdeeq karne waali hai, aur Taurait o Injeel bhi naazil ki hai

Is se pehle logon ke liye hidaayat bana kar, aur haq o baatil mein farq karne waali kitaab bhi naazil ki hai. Beshak jo log aayaat-e-Ilaahi ka inkaar karte hain un ke waaste shadeed azaab hai, aur Khuda sakht intiqaam lene waala hai
Khuda ke liye aasmaan o zameen ki koi shai makhfi nahin hai
Woh Khuda jis tarah chaahta hai reham-e-maadar ke andar tasweerein banaata hai. Us ke ilaawa koi khuda nahin hai, woh saahib-e-izzat bhi hai aur saahib-e-hikmat bhi

Us ne aap par woh kitaab naazil ki hai jis mein se kuch aayatein muhkam aur waazeh hain jo asl-e-kitaab hain, aur kuch mutashaabeh hain. Ab jin ke dilon mein kaji hai woh unhi mutashaabehaat ke peechhe lag jaate hain taake fitna barpa karein aur man-maani taaweelein karein, haalaanke us ki taaweel ka ilm sirf Khuda ko hai aur unhein jo ilm mein rusookh rakhne waale hain, jin ka kehna yeh hai ke hum is kitaab par imaan rakhte hain aur yeh sab ki sab muhkam o mutashaabeh hamaare Parwardigar hi ki taraf se hai, aur yeh baat siwaaye saahibaan-e-aql ke koi nahin samajh sakta hai
Un ka kehna hai ke Parwardigar! Jab tu ne humein hidaayat de di hai to ab hamaare dilon mein kaji na paida hone paaye, aur humein apne paas se rehmat ata farma ke tu behtareen ata karne waala hai
Khudaya! Tu tamaam insaanon ko us din jama karne waala hai jis mein koi shak nahin hai, aur Allah ka wa'da ghalat nahin hota
Jo log kaafir ho gaye hain un ke amwaal o aulaad kuch bhi kaam aane waale nahin hain, aur woh Jahannam ka eendhan banne waale hain

Un ka haal bhi Fir'auniyon aur un se pehle logon ka sa hoga jinhon ne hamaari aayaat ko jhutlaaya, pas Allah ne inhein un ke gunaahon ki wajah se giraft mein le liya, aur Allah sakht azaab dene waala hai
(Ae Rasool!) Jinhon ne inkaar kiya hai un se keh dijiye: tum anqareeb maghloob ho jaaoge aur Jahannam ki taraf ikatthe kiye jaaoge, aur woh badtareen thikaana hai

Tumhaare waaste un donon girohon ke haalaat mein ek nishaani maujood hai jo maidaan-e-jang mein aamne saamne aaye, ke ek giroh raah-e-Khuda mein jihaad kar raha tha aur doosra kaafir tha jo un momineen ko apne se dugna dekh raha tha, aur Allah apni nusrat ke zariye jis ki chaahta hai taaeed karta hai, aur is mein saahibaan-e-nazar ke waaste saamaan-e-ibrat o naseehat bhi hai

Logon ke liye khwaahishaat-e-duniya: auratein, aulaad, sone chaandi ke dher, tandurust ghode ya chaupaaye, khetiyaan sab muzayyan aur aaraasta kar di gayi hain, ke yahi mataa'-e-duniya hai aur Allah ke paas behtareen anjaam hai

Paighambar! Aap keh dein ke kya main un sab se behtar cheez ki khabar doon? Jo log taqwa ikhtiyaar karne waale hain un ke liye Parwardigar ke yahaan woh baaghaat hain jin ke neeche nahrein jaari hain aur woh un mein hamesha rehne waale hain. Un ke liye paakeeza biwiyaan hain aur Allah ki khushnoodi hai, aur Allah apne bandon ke haalaat se khoob baakhabar hai
Qaabil-e-ta'reef hain woh log jo yeh kehte hain ke Parwardigar! Hum imaan le aaye, hamaare gunaahon ko bakhsh de aur humein aatish-e-Jahannam se bacha le
Yeh sab sabr karne waale, sach bolne waale, itaa'at karne waale, raah-e-Khuda mein kharch karne waale aur hangaam-e-sahar istighfaar karne waale hain
Allah khud gawaah hai ke us ke ilaawa koi khuda nahin hai, malaaika aur saahibaan-e-ilm gawaah hain ke woh adl ke saath qaaim hai. Us ke ilaawa koi khuda nahin hai aur woh saahib-e-izzat o hikmat hai

Deen Allah ke nazdeek sirf Islam hai, aur ahl-e-kitaab ne ilm aane ke baad hi jhagda shuroo kiya hai, sirf aapas ki sharaaraton ki bina par, aur jo bhi aayaat-e-Ilaahi ka inkaar karega to Khuda bahut jald hisaab karne waala hai

Ae Paighambar! Agar yeh log aap se kat-hujjati karein to keh dijiye ke mera rukh tamaam-tar Allah ki taraf hai aur mere pairau bhi aise hi hain. Aur phir ahl-e-kitaab aur jaahil mushrikeen se poochhiye kya tum Islam le aaye? Agar woh Islam le aaye to goya hidaayat pa gaye, aur agar munh pher liya to aap ka farz sirf tableegh tha, aur Allah apne bandon ko khoob pehchaanta hai
Jo log aayaat-e-Ilaahiya ka inkaar karte hain aur naahaq ambiya ko qatl karte hain aur un logon ko qatl karte hain jo adl o insaaf ka hukm dene waale hain, inhein dardnaak azaab ki khabar suna dijiye
Yahi woh log hain jin ke aamaal duniya mein bhi barbaad ho gaye aur aakhirat mein bhi un ka koi madadgaar nahin hai

Kya tum ne un logon ko nahin dekha jinhein kitaab ka thoda sa hissa de diya gaya, ke inhein kitaab-e-Khuda ki taraf faisle ke liye bulaaya jaata hai to ek fareeq mukar jaata hai aur woh bilkul kinaara-kashi karne waale hain
Yeh is liye ke un ka aqeeda hai ke inhein aatish-e-Jahannam sirf chand din ke liye chhooegi, aur un ko deen ke baare mein un ki iftira-pardaaziyon ne dhoke mein rakha hai

Us waqt kya hoga jab hum sab ko us din jama karenge jis mein kisi shak aur shubhe ki gunjaaish nahin hai, aur har nafs ko us ke kiye ka poora poora badla diya jaaega, aur kisi par koi zulm nahin kiya jaaega

Paighambar! Aap kahiye ke Khudaya! Tu saahib-e-iqtidaar hai, jis ko chaahta hai iqtidaar deta hai aur jis se chaahta hai salb kar leta hai, jis ko chaahta hai izzat deta hai aur jis ko chaahta hai zaleel karta hai. Saara khair tere haath mein hai aur tu hi har shai par qaadir hai
Tu raat ko din aur din ko raat mein daakhil karta hai, aur murda ko zinda se aur zinda ko murda se nikaalta hai, aur jise chaahta hai be-hisaab rizq deta hai

Khabardaar saahibaan-e-imaan momineen ko chhod kar kuffaar ko apna waali aur sarparast na banaayein, ke jo bhi aisa karega us ka Khuda se koi ta'alluq na hoga, magar yeh ke tumhein kuffaar se khauf ho to koi harj bhi nahin hai. Aur Khuda tumhein apni hasti se daraata hai, aur usi ki taraf palat kar jaana hai

Aap un se keh dijiye ke tum dil ki baaton ko chhupaao ya un ka izhaar karo, Khuda to bahar-haal jaanta hai, aur woh zameen o aasmaan ki har cheez ko jaanta hai aur har shai par qudrat o ikhtiyaar rakhne waala bhi hai

Us din ko yaad karo jab har nafs apne nek aamaal ko bhi haazir paaega aur aamaal-e-bad ko bhi, jin ko dekh kar yeh tamanna karega ke kaash hamaare aur un bure aamaal ke darmiyaan taweel faasla ho jaata. Aur Khuda tumhein apni hasti se daraata hai, aur woh apne bandon par meharbaan bhi hai

Ae Paighambar! Keh dijiye ke agar tum log Allah se mohabbat karte ho to meri pairavi karo, Khuda bhi tum se mohabbat karega aur tumhaare gunaahon ko bakhsh dega, ke woh bada bakhshne waala aur meharbaan hai
Keh dijiye ke Allah aur Rasool ki itaa'at karo, ke jo is se roo-gardaani karega to Khuda kaafireen ko hargiz dost nahin rakhta hai
Allah ne Aadam, Nooh aur Aal-e-Ibraheem aur Aal-e-Imraan ko muntakhab kar liya hai
Yeh ek nasl hai jis mein ek ka silsila ek se hai, aur Allah sab ki sunne waala aur jaanne waala hai

Us waqt ko yaad karo jab Imraan ki zauja ne kaha ke Parwardigar! Main ne apne shikam ke bachche ko tere ghar ki khidmat ke liye nazr kar diya hai, ab tu qubool farma le ke tu har ek ki sunne waala aur niyyaton ka jaanne waala hai

Us ke baad jab wilaadat hui to unhon ne kaha Parwardigar! Yeh to ladki hai, haalaanke Allah khoob jaanta hai ke woh kya hai, aur woh jaanta hai ke ladka is ladki jaisa nahin ho sakta. Aur main ne is ka naam Maryam rakha hai, aur main ise aur is ki aulaad ko Shaitaan-e-rajeem se teri panaah mein deti hoon

To Khuda ne use behtareen andaaz se qubool kar liya aur us ki behtareen nashw o numa ka intizaam farma diya, aur Zakariya ne us ki kafaalat ki. Ke jab Zakariya mehraab-e-ibaadat mein daakhil hote to Maryam ke paas rizq dekhte aur poochhte ke yeh kahaan se aaya? Aur Maryam jawaab deteen ke yeh sab Khuda ki taraf se hai, woh jise chaahta hai rizq be-hisaab ata kar deta hai
Us waqt Zakariya ne apne Parwardigar se dua ki ke mujhe apni taraf se ek paakeeza aulaad ata farma ke tu har ek ki dua ka sunne waala hai

To malaaika ne inhein us waqt aawaaz di jab woh mehraab mein khade masroof-e-ibaadat the, ke Khuda tumhein Yahya ki bashaarat de raha hai jo us ke kalime ki tasdeeq karne waala, sardaar, paakeeza-kirdaar aur saaliheen mein se nabi hoga
Unhon ne arz ki ke mere yahaan kis tarah aulaad hogi jab ke mujh par budhaapa aa gaya hai aur meri aurat bhi baanjh hai? To irshaad hua ke Khuda isi tarah jo chaahta hai karta hai

Unhon ne kaha ke Parwardigar! Mere liye qabooliyat-e-dua ki koi alaamat qaraar de de. Irshaad hua ke tum teen din tak ishaaron ke ilaawa baat na kar sakoge, aur Khuda ka zikr kasrat se karte rehna aur subh o shaam us ki tasbeeh karte rehna
Aur us waqt ko yaad karo jab malaaika ne Maryam ko aawaaz di ke Khuda ne tumhein chun liya hai aur paakeeza bana diya hai aur aalameen ki auraton mein muntakhab qaraar de diya hai
Ae Maryam! Tum apne Parwardigar ki itaa'at karo, sajda karo aur rukoo' karne waalon ke saath rukoo' karo

Paighambar! Yeh ghaib ki khabrein hain jin ki wahi hum aap ki taraf kar rahe hain, aur aap to un ke paas nahin the jab woh qur'a daal rahe the ke Maryam ki kafaalat kaun karega, aur aap un ke paas nahin the jab woh is mauzoo' par jhagda kar rahe the

Aur us waqt ko yaad karo jab malaaika ne kaha ke ae Maryam! Khuda tum ko apne kalime Maseeh Eesa ibn-e-Maryam ki bashaarat de raha hai jo duniya aur aakhirat mein saahib-e-wajaahat aur muqarrabeen-e-baargaah-e-Ilaahi mein se hai
Woh logon se gahwaare mein bhi baat karega aur bharpoor jawaan hone ke baad bhi, aur saaliheen mein se hoga

Maryam ne kaha ke mere yahaan farzand kis tarah hoga jab ke mujh ko kisi bashar ne chhua bhi nahin hai? Irshaad hua ke isi tarah Khuda jo chaahta hai paida karta hai. Jab woh kisi kaam ka faisla kar leta hai to kehta hai ke ho ja aur woh cheez ho jaati hai
Aur Khuda is farzand ko kitaab o hikmat aur Taurait o Injeel ki ta'leem dega

Aur use Bani Israaeel ki taraf rasool banaaega, aur woh un se kahega ke main tumhaare paas tumhaare Parwardigar ki taraf se nishaani le kar aaya hoon, ke main tumhaare liye mitti se parinde ki shakl banaaoonga aur us mein kuch dam kar doonga to woh hukm-e-Khuda se parinda ban jaaega, aur main paidaaishi andhe aur mabroos ka ilaaj karoonga, aur hukm-e-Khuda se murdon ko zinda karoonga, aur tumhein is baat ki khabar doonga ke tum kya khaate ho aur kya ghar mein zakheera karte ho. In sab mein tumhaare liye nishaaniyaan hain agar tum saahibaan-e-imaan ho

Aur main apne pehle ki kitaab Taurait ki tasdeeq karne waala hoon, aur main ba'z un cheezon ko halaal qaraar doonga jo tum par haraam thin, aur tumhaare Parwardigar ki taraf se nishaani le kar aaya hoon, lihaaza us se daro aur meri itaa'at karo
Allah mera aur tumhaara donon ka Rab hai, lihaaza us ki ibaadat karo ke yahi siraat-e-mustaqeem hai

Phir jab Eesa ne qaum se kufr ka ehsaas kiya to farmaaya ke kaun hai jo Khuda ki raah mein mera madadgaar ho? Hawaariyeen ne kaha ke hum Allah ke madadgaar hain, us par imaan laaye hain aur aap gawaah rahein ke hum Musalmaan hain
Parwardigar! Hum un tamaam baaton par imaan le aaye jo tu ne naazil ki hain aur tere Rasool ka ittibaa' kiya, lihaaza hamaara naam apne Rasool ke gawaahon mein darj kar le
Aur Yahoodiyon ne Eesa se makkaari ki to Allah ne bhi jawaabi tadbeer ki, aur Khuda behtareen tadbeer karne waala hai

Aur jab Khuda ne farmaaya ke Eesa! Hum tumhaari muddat-e-qiyaam-e-duniya poori karne waale aur tumhein apni taraf utha lene waale aur tumhein kuffaar ki khabaasat se najaat dilaane waale aur tumhaari pairavi karne waalon ko inkaar karne waalon par qiyaamat tak ki bartari dene waale hain. Us ke baad tum sab ki baazgasht hamaari taraf hogi aur hum tumhaare ikhtilaafaat ka saheeh faisla kar denge
Phir jin logon ne kufr ikhtiyaar kiya un par duniya aur aakhirat mein shadeed azaab karenge aur un ka koi madadgaar na hoga
Aur jo log imaan le aaye aur unhon ne nek aamaal kiye un ko mukammal ajr denge, aur Khuda zulm karne waalon ko pasand nahin karta
Yeh tamaam nishaaniyaan aur pur-az-hikmat tazkire hain jo hum aap se bayaan kar rahe hain
Eesa ki misaal Allah ke nazdeek Aadam jaisi hai ke inhein mitti se paida kiya aur phir kaha ho ja aur woh ho gaya
Haq tumhaare Parwardigar ki taraf se aa chuka hai, lihaaza khabardaar ab tumhaara shumaar shak karne waalon mein na hona chaahiye

Paighambar! Ilm ke aa jaane ke baad jo log tum se kat-hujjati karein un se keh dijiye ke aao hum log apne apne farzand, apni apni auratein aur apne apne nafson ko bulaayein aur phir Khuda ki baargaah mein dua karein aur jhooton par Khuda ki la'nat qaraar dein
Yeh sab haqeeqi waaqe'aat hain, aur Khuda ke ilaawa koi doosra khuda nahin hai, aur wahi Khuda saahib-e-izzat o hikmat hai
Ab us ke baad bhi yeh log inhiraaf karein to Khuda mufsideen ko khoob jaanta hai

Ae Paighambar! Aap keh dein ke ahl-e-kitaab! Aao ek munsifaana kalime par ittifaaq kar lein ke Khuda ke ilaawa kisi ki ibaadat na karein, kisi ko us ka shareek na banaayein, aapas mein ek doosre ko khudaai ka darja na dein. Aur us ke baad bhi yeh log munh modein to keh dijiye ke tum log bhi gawaah rehna ke hum log haqeeqi Musalmaan aur itaa'at-guzaar hain
Ae ahl-e-kitaab! Aakhir Ibraheem ke baare mein kyon behs karte ho jab ke Taurait aur Injeel un ke baad naazil hui hai? Kya tumhein itni bhi aql nahin hai
Ab tak tum ne un baaton mein behs ki hai jin ka kuch ilm tha, to ab us baat mein kyon behs karte ho jis ka kuch bhi ilm nahin hai? Beshak Khuda jaanta hai aur tum nahin jaante ho
Ibraheem na Yahoodi the aur na Eesaai, woh Musalmaan haq-parast aur baatil se kinaara-kash the, aur woh mushrikeen mein se hargiz nahin the
Yaqeenan Ibraheem se qareeb-tar un ke pairau hain, aur phir yeh Paighambar aur saahibaan-e-imaan hain, aur Allah saahibaan-e-imaan ka sarparast hai
Ahl-e-kitaab ka ek giroh yeh chaahta hai ke tum logon ko gumraah kar de, haalaanke yeh apne hi ko gumraah kar rahe hain aur samajhte bhi nahin hain
Ae ahl-e-kitaab! Tum aayaat-e-Ilaahiya ka inkaar kyon kar rahe ho jab ke tum khud hi un ke gawaah bhi ho
Ae ahl-e-kitaab! Kyon haq ko baatil se mushtabah karte ho aur jaante hue haq ki parda-poshi karte ho
Aur ahl-e-kitaab ki ek jamaa'at ne apne saathiyon se kaha ke jo kuch imaan waalon par naazil hua hai us par subh ko imaan le aao aur shaam ko inkaar kar do, shaayad is tarah woh log bhi palat jaayein

Aur khabardaar un logon ke ilaawa kisi par e'tebaar na karna jo tumhaare deen ka ittibaa' karte hain. Paighambar! Aap keh dein ke hidaayat sirf Khuda ki hidaayat hai. Aur hargiz yeh na maanna ke Khuda waisi hi fazeelat aur nubuwwat kisi aur ko bhi de sakta hai jaisi tum ko di hai, ya koi tum se pesh-e-Parwardigar behs bhi kar sakta hai. Paighambar! Aap keh dijiye ke fazl o karam Khuda ke haath mein hai, woh jise chaahta hai ata karta hai, aur woh saahib-e-wus'at bhi hai aur saahib-e-ilm bhi
Woh apni rehmat se jise chaahta hai makhsoos karta hai, aur woh bade fazl waala hai

Aur ahl-e-kitaab mein se kuch aise bhi hain jin ke paas dher bhar maal bhi amaanat rakh diya jaaye to waapas kar denge, aur kuch aise bhi hain ke ek dinaar bhi amaanat rakh di jaaye to us waqt tak waapas na karenge jab tak un ke sar par khade na raho. Yeh is liye ke un ka kehna yeh hai ke Arabon ki taraf se hamaare oopar koi zimmedaari nahin hai. Yeh Khuda ke khilaaf jhoot bolte hain aur jaante bhi hain ke jhoote hain
Beshak jo apne ahd ko poora karega aur khauf-e-Khuda paida karega, to Khuda muttaqeen ko dost rakhta hai

Jo log Allah se kiye gaye ahd aur qasam ko thodi qeemat par bech daalte hain un ke liye aakhirat mein koi hissa nahin hai, aur na Khuda un se baat karega aur na roz-e-qiyaamat un ki taraf nazar karega aur na inhein gunaahon ki aaloodgi se paak banaaega, aur un ke liye dardnaak azaab hai

Unhi Yahoodiyon mein se ba'z woh hain jo kitaab padhne mein zabaan ko tod mod dete hain taake tum log is tahreef ko bhi asl-e-kitaab samajhne lago, haalaanke woh asl-e-kitaab nahin hai, aur yeh log kehte hain ke yeh sab Allah ki taraf se hai haalaanke Allah ki taraf se hargiz nahin hai. Yeh Khuda ke khilaaf jhoot bolte hain haalaanke sab jaante hain

Kisi bashar ke liye yeh munaasib nahin hai ke Khuda use kitaab o hikmat aur nubuwwat ata kar de aur phir woh logon se yeh kehne lage ke Khuda ko chhod kar hamaare bande ban jaao, balke us ka qaul yahi hota hai ke Allah waale bano ke tum kitaab ki ta'leem bhi dete ho aur use padhte bhi rehte ho
Woh yeh hukm bhi nahin de sakta ke malaaika ya ambiya ko apna Parwardigar bana lo. Kya woh tumhein kufr ka hukm de sakta hai jab ke tum log Musalmaan ho

Aur us waqt ko yaad karo jab Khuda ne tamaam ambiya se ahd liya ke hum tum ko jo kitaab o hikmat de rahe hain, us ke baad jab woh Rasool aa jaaye jo tumhaari kitaabon ki tasdeeq karne waala hai to tum sab us par imaan le aana aur us ki madad karna. Aur phir poochha kya tum ne in baaton ka iqraar kar liya aur hamaare ahd ko qubool kar liya? To sab ne kaha beshak hum ne iqraar kar liya. Irshaad hua ke ab tum sab gawaah bhi rehna aur main bhi tumhaare saath gawaahon mein hoon
Us ke baad jo inhiraaf karega woh faasiqeen ki manzil mein hoga

Kya yeh log deen-e-Khuda ke ilaawa kuch aur talaash kar rahe hain, jab ke zameen o aasmaan ki saari makhlooqaat ba-razaa o raghbat ya ba-jabr o karaahat usi ki baargaah mein sar-e-tasleem kham kiye hue hai, aur sab ko usi ki baargaah mein waapas jaana hai

Paighambar! Un se keh dijiye ke hamaara imaan Allah par hai, aur jo hum par naazil hua hai, aur jo Ibraheem, Ismaaeel, Is'haaq, Ya'qoob aur Asbaat par naazil hua hai, aur jo Moosa, Eesa aur ambiya ko Khuda ki taraf se diya gaya hai, un sab par hai. Hum un ke darmiyaan tafreeq nahin karte hain aur hum Khuda ke itaa'at-guzaar bande hain
Aur jo Islam ke ilaawa koi bhi deen talaash karega to woh deen us se qubool na kiya jaaega, aur woh qiyaamat ke din khasaare waalon mein hoga

Khuda us qaum ko kis tarah hidaayat dega jo imaan ke baad kaafir ho gayi, aur woh khud gawaah hai ke Rasool barhaq hai aur un ke paas khuli nishaaniyaan bhi aa chuki hain? Beshak Khuda zaalim qaum ko hidaayat nahin deta
Un logon ki jaza yeh hai ke un par Khuda, malaaika aur insaan sab ki la'nat hai
Yeh hamesha isi la'nat mein giraftaar rahenge, un ke azaab mein takhfeef na hogi aur na inhein mohlat di jaaegi
Ilaawa un logon ke jinhon ne us ke baad tauba kar li aur islaah kar li, ke Khuda Ghafoor aur Raheem hai
Jin logon ne imaan ke baad kufr ikhtiyaar kar liya aur phir kufr mein badhte hi chale gaye un ki tauba hargiz qubool na hogi, aur woh haqeeqi taur par gumraah hain

Jin logon ne kufr ikhtiyaar kiya aur usi kufr ki haalat mein mar gaye un se saari zameen bhar kar sona bhi ba-taur-e-fidya qubool nahin kiya jaaega, aur un ke liye dardnaak azaab hai aur un ka koi madadgaar nahin hai
Tum neki ki manzil tak nahin pahunch sakte jab tak apni mehboob cheezon mein se raah-e-Khuda mein infaaq na karo, aur jo kuch bhi infaaq karoge Khuda us se bilkul baakhabar hai

Bani Israaeel ke liye tamaam khaane halaal the siwaaye us ke jise Taurait ke naazil hone se pehle Israaeel ne apne oopar mamnoo' qaraar de liya tha. Ab tum Taurait ko padho agar tum apne da'we mein sachche ho
Us ke baad jo bhi Khuda par bohtaan rakhega us ka shumaar zaalimeen mein hoga
Paighambar! Aap keh dijiye ke Khuda sachcha hai. Tum sab millat-e-Ibraheem ka ittibaa' karo, woh baatil se kinaara-kash the aur mushrikeen mein se nahin the
Beshak sab se pehla makaan jo logon ke liye banaaya gaya hai woh Makka mein hai, mubaarak hai aur aalameen ke liye mujassam hidaayat hai

Us mein khuli hui nishaaniyaan, Maqaam-e-Ibraheem hai, aur jo us mein daakhil ho jaaega woh mahfooz ho jaaega, aur Allah ke liye logon par us ghar ka Hajj karna waajib hai agar us raah ki istitaa'at rakhte hon, aur jo kaafir ho jaaye to Khuda tamaam aalameen se be-niyaaz hai
Ae ahl-e-kitaab! Kyon aayaat-e-Ilaahi ka inkaar karte ho jab ke Khuda tumhaare aamaal ka gawaah hai
Kahiye ae ahl-e-kitaab! Kyon saahibaan-e-imaan ko raah-e-Khuda se rokte ho aur us mein kaji talaash karte ho, jab ke tum khud us ki sehhat ke gawaah ho, aur Allah tumhaare aamaal se ghaafil nahin hai
Ae imaan waalo! Agar tum ne ahl-e-kitaab ke is giroh ki itaa'at kar li to yeh tum ko imaan ke baad kufr ki taraf palta denge

Aur tum log kis tarah kaafir ho jaaoge jab ke tumhaare saamne aayaat-e-Ilaahiya ki tilaawat ho rahi hai aur tumhaare darmiyaan Rasool maujood hai? Aur jo Khuda se waabasta ho jaaye samjho ke use seedhe raaste ki hidaayat kar di gayi
Imaan waalo! Allah se is tarah daro jo darne ka haq hai, aur khabardaar us waqt tak na marna jab tak Musalmaan na ho jaao

Aur Allah ki rassi ko mazbooti se pakde raho aur aapas mein tafriqa na paida karo, aur Allah ki ne'mat ko yaad karo ke tum log aapas mein dushman the, us ne tumhaare dilon mein ulfat paida kar di to tum us ki ne'mat se bhaai bhaai ban gaye, aur tum Jahannam ke kinaare par the to us ne tumhein nikaal liya, aur Allah isi tarah apni aayatein bayaan karta hai ke shaayad tum hidaayat-yaafta ban jaao
Aur tum mein se ek giroh ko aisa hona chaahiye jo khair ki daawat de, nekiyon ka hukm de, buraaiyon se mana' kare, aur yahi log najaat-yaafta hain
Aur khabardaar un logon ki tarah na ho jaao jinhon ne tafriqa paida kiya aur waazeh nishaaniyon ke aa jaane ke baad bhi ikhtilaaf kiya, ke un ke liye azaab-e-azeem hai
Qiyaamat ke din jab ba'z chehre safed honge aur ba'z siyaah. Jin ke chehre siyaah honge un se kaha jaaega ke tum imaan ke baad kyon kaafir ho gaye the? Ab apne kufr ki bina par azaab ka maza chakho
Aur jin ke chehre safed aur raushan honge woh rehmat-e-Ilaahi mein hamesha hamesha rahenge
Yeh aayaat-e-Ilaahi hain jin ki hum haq ke saath tilaawat kar rahe hain, aur Allah aalameen ke baare mein hargiz zulm nahin chaahta
Zameen o aasmaan mein jo kuch hai sab Allah ke liye hai aur usi ki taraf saare umoor ki baazgasht hai

Tum behtareen ummat ho jise logon ke liye manzar-e-aam par laaya gaya hai. Tum logon ko nekiyon ka hukm dete ho aur buraaiyon se rokte ho aur Allah par imaan rakhte ho. Aur agar ahl-e-kitaab bhi imaan le aate to un ke haq mein behtar hota, lekin un mein sirf chand momineen hain aur aksariyat faasiq hai
Yeh tum ko aziyyat ke ilaawa koi nuqsaan nahin pahuncha sakte, aur agar tum se jang bhi karenge to maidaan chhod kar bhaag jaayenge aur phir un ki madad bhi na ki jaaegi

Un par zillat ke nishaan laga diye gaye hain, yeh jahaan bhi rahein, magar yeh ke Khudaai ahd ya logon ke mu'aahide ki panaah mil jaaye. Yeh ghazab-e-Ilaahi mein rahenge aur un par maskanat ki maar rahegi. Yeh is liye hai ke yeh aayaat-e-Ilaahi ka inkaar karte the aur naahaq ambiya ko qatl karte the. Yeh is liye ke yeh naafarmaan the aur ziyaadatiyaan kiya karte the
Yeh log bhi sab ek jaise nahin hain. Ahl-e-kitaab hi mein woh jamaa'at bhi hai jo deen par qaaim hai, raaton ko aayaat-e-Ilaahi ki tilaawat karti hai aur sajda karti hai
Yeh Allah aur aakhirat par imaan rakhte hain, nekiyon ka hukm dete hain, buraaiyon se rokte hain aur nekiyon ki taraf sabqat karte hain, aur yahi log saaliheen aur nek-kirdaaron mein hain
Yeh jo bhi khair karenge us ka inkaar na kiya jaaega, aur Allah muttaqeen ke aamaal se khoob baakhabar hai
Jin logon ne kufr ikhtiyaar kiya un ke maal o aulaad kuch kaam na aayenge, aur yeh haqeeqi Jahannami hain aur wahin hamesha rehne waale hain

Yeh log zindagaani-e-duniya mein jo kuch kharch karte hain us ki misaal us hawa ki hai jis mein bahut paala ho aur woh us qaum ke kheton par gir pade jinhon ne apne oopar zulm kiya hai aur use tabaah kar de, aur yeh zulm un par Khuda ne nahin kiya hai balke yeh khud apne oopar zulm karte hain

Ae imaan waalo! Khabardaar ghairon ko apna raazdaar na banaana, yeh tumhein nuqsaan pahunchaane mein koi kotaahi na karenge. Yeh sirf tumhaari mashaqqat o museebat ke khwaahishmand hain. Un ki adaawat zabaan se bhi zaahir hai aur jo dil mein chhupa rakha hai woh to bahut ziyaada hai. Hum ne tumhaare liye nishaaniyon ko waazeh kar ke bayaan kar diya hai agar tum saahibaan-e-aql ho

Khabardaar! Tum un se dosti karte ho aur yeh tum se dosti nahin karte hain. Tum tamaam kitaabon par imaan rakhte ho, aur yeh jab tum se milte hain to kehte hain ke hum imaan le aaye, aur jab akele hote hain to ghusse se ungliyaan kaat-te hain. Paighambar! Aap keh dijiye ke tum isi ghusse mein mar jaao, Khuda sab ke dil ke haalaat se khoob baakhabar hai

Tumhein zara bhi neki mile to inhein bura lagega, aur tumhein takleef pahunch jaaegi to khush honge. Aur agar tum sabr karo aur taqwa ikhtiyaar karo to un ke makr se koi nuqsaan na hoga, Khuda un ke aamaal ka ihaata kiye hue hai
Us waqt ko yaad karo jab tum subh-sawere ghar se nikal pade aur momineen ko jang ki position bata rahe the, aur Khuda sab kuch sunne waala aur jaanne waala hai
Us waqt jab tum mein se do girohon ne susti ka muzaahira karna chaaha lekin bach gaye ke Allah un ka sarparast tha, aur usi par imaan waalon ko bharosa karna chaahiye
Aur Allah ne Badr mein tumhaari madad ki hai jab ke tum kamzor the, lihaaza Allah se daro shaayad tum shukr-guzaar ban jaao
Us waqt jab aap momineen se keh rahe the ke kya yeh tumhaare liye kaafi nahin hai ke Khuda teen hazaar farishton ko naazil kar ke tumhaari madad kare
Yaqeenan agar tum sabr karoge aur taqwa ikhtiyaar karoge aur dushman fil-faur tum tak aa jaayenge to Khuda paanch hazaar farishton se tumhaari madad karega jin par bahaaduri ke nishaan lage honge
Aur is imdaad ko Khuda ne sirf tumhaare liye bashaarat aur itminaan-e-qalb ka saamaan qaraar diya hai, warna madad to hamesha sirf Khuda-e-Azeez o Hakeem hi ki taraf se hoti hai
Taake kuffaar ke ek hisse ko kaat de ya un ko zaleel kar de ke woh ruswa ho kar palat jaayein
In mu'aamalaat mein aap ka koi hissa nahin hai, chaahe Khuda tauba qubool kare ya azaab kare, yeh sab bahar-haal zaalim hain
Aur Allah hi ke liye zameen o aasmaan ki kul kaainaat hai, woh jis ko chaahta hai bakhsh deta hai aur jis par chaahta hai azaab karta hai, woh Ghafoor bhi hai aur Raheem bhi hai
Ae imaan waalo! Yeh dugna chauguna sood na khaao aur Allah se daro ke shaayad najaat pa jaao
Aur us aag se bacho jo kaafiron ke waaste muhayya ki gayi hai
Aur Allah o Rasool ki itaa'at karo ke shaayad reham ke qaabil ho jaao
Aur apne Parwardigar ki maghfirat aur us jannat ki taraf sabqat karo jis ki wus'at zameen o aasmaan ke baraabar hai, aur use un saahibaan-e-taqwa ke liye muhayya kiya gaya hai
Jo raahat aur sakhti har haal mein infaaq karte hain, aur ghusse ko pi jaate hain, aur logon ko maaf karne waale hain, aur Khuda ehsaan karne waalon ko dost rakhta hai

Woh log woh hain ke jab koi numaayaan gunaah karte hain ya apne nafs par zulm karte hain to Khuda ko yaad kar ke apne gunaahon par istighfaar karte hain, aur Khuda ke ilaawa kaun gunaahon ka maaf karne waala hai? Aur woh apne kiye par jaan boojh kar israar nahin karte
Yahi woh hain jin ki jaza maghfirat hai, aur woh jannat hai jis ke neeche nahrein jaari hain, woh usi mein hamesha rehne waale hain, aur amal karne ki yeh jaza behtareen jaza hai
Tum se pehle misaalein guzar chuki hain, ab tum zameen mein sair karo aur dekho ke jhutlaane waalon ka kya anjaam hota hai
Yeh aam insaanon ke liye ek bayaan-e-haqaaiq hai aur saahibaan-e-taqwa ke liye hidaayat aur naseehat hai
Khabardaar susti na karna, masaaib par mahzoon na hona, agar tum saahib-e-imaan ho to sar-bulandi tumhaare hi liye hai

Agar tumhein koi takleef chhoo leti hai to qaum ko bhi is se pehle aisi hi takleef ho chuki hai, aur hum to zamaane ko logon ke darmiyaan ulatte palatte rehte hain taake Khuda saahibaan-e-imaan ko dekh le aur tum mein se ba'z ko shuhada qaraar de, aur woh zaalimeen ko dost nahin rakhta hai
Aur Khuda saahibaan-e-imaan ko chhaant kar alag karna chaahta tha aur kaafiron ko mita dena chaahta tha
Kya tumhaara yeh khayaal hai ke tum jannat mein yunhi daakhil ho jaaoge jab ke Khuda ne tum mein se jihaad karne waalon aur sabr karne waalon ko bhi nahin jaana hai
Tum maut ki mulaaqaat se pehle us ki bahut tamanna kiya karte the, aur jaise hi use dekha dekhte hi reh gaye

Aur Muhammad to sirf ek rasool hain jin se pehle bahut se rasool guzar chuke hain. Kya agar woh mar jaayein ya qatl ho jaayein to tum ulte pairon palat jaaoge? To jo bhi aisa karega woh Khuda ka koi nuqsaan nahin karega, aur Khuda to anqareeb shukr-guzaaron ko un ki jaza dega

Koi nafs bhi izn-e-Parwardigar ke baghair nahin mar sakta hai, sab ki ek ajal aur muddat mu'ayyan hai. Aur jo duniya hi mein badla chaahega hum use woh denge, aur jo aakhirat ka sawaab chaahega hum use us mein se ata kar denge, aur hum anqareeb shukr-guzaaron ko jaza denge

Aur bahut se aise nabi guzar chuke hain jin ke saath bahut se Allah waalon ne is shaan se jihaad kiya hai ke raah-e-Khuda mein padne waali museebaton se na kamzor hue aur na buzdili ka izhaar kiya aur na dushman ke saamne zillat ka muzaahira kiya, aur Allah sabr karne waalon hi ko dost rakhta hai
Un ka qaul sirf yahi tha ke Khudaya! Hamaare gunaahon ko bakhsh de, hamaare umoor mein ziyaadatiyon ko maaf farma, hamaare qadmon ko sabaat ata farma aur kaafiron ke muqaable mein hamaari madad farma
To Khuda ne inhein mu'aawaza bhi diya aur aakhirat ka behtareen sawaab bhi diya, aur Allah nek amal karne waalon ko dost rakhta hai
Imaan waalo! Agar tum kufr ikhtiyaar karne waalon ki itaa'at kar loge to yeh tumhein ulte paaon palta le jaayenge aur phir tum hi ulte khasaare waalon mein ho jaaoge
Balke Khuda tumhaara sarparast hai aur woh behtareen madad karne waala hai

Hum anqareeb kaafiron ke dilon mein tumhaara ro'b daal denge, ke unhon ne us ko Khuda ka shareek banaaya hai jis ke baare mein Khuda ne koi daleel naazil nahin ki hai, aur un ka anjaam Jahannam hoga aur woh zaalimeen ka badtareen thikaana hai

Khuda ne apna wa'da us waqt poora kar diya jab tum us ke hukm se kuffaar ko qatl kar rahe the, yahaan tak ke tum ne kamzori ka muzaahira kiya aur aapas mein jhagda karne lage, aur us waqt Khuda ki naafarmaani ki jab us ne tumhaari mehboob shai ko dikhla diya tha. Tum mein kuch duniya ke talabgaar the aur kuch aakhirat ke. Us ke baad tum ko un kuffaar ki taraf se pher diya taake tumhaara imtehaan liya jaaye, aur phir us ne tumhein maaf bhi kar diya, ke woh saahibaan-e-imaan par bada fazl o karam karne waala hai

Us waqt ko yaad karo jab tum bulandi par ja rahe the aur mud kar kisi ko dekhte bhi na the, jab ke Rasool peechhe khade tumhein aawaaz de rahe the, jis ke nateeje mein Khuda ne tumhein gham ke badle gham diya taake na us par ranjeeda ho jo cheez haath se nikal gayi aur na us museebat par jo naazil ho gayi hai, aur Allah tumhaare aamaal se khoob baakhabar hai

Us ke baad Khuda ne ek giroh par pur-sukoon neend taari kar di, aur ek ko neend bhi na aayi ke use sirf apni jaan ki fikr thi, aur un ke zehn mein khilaaf-e-haq jaahiliyat jaise khayaalaat the, aur woh yeh keh rahe the ke jang ke mu'aamalaat mein hamaara kya ikhtiyaar hai? Paighambar! Aap keh dijiye ke ikhtiyaar sirf Khuda ka hai. Yeh apne dil mein woh baatein chhupaaye hue hain jin ka aap se izhaar nahin karte, aur kehte hain ke agar ikhtiyaar hamaare haath mein hota to hum yahaan na maare jaate. To aap keh dijiye ke agar tum gharon mein bhi reh jaate to jin ke liye shahaadat likh di gayi hai woh apne maqtal tak bahar-haal jaate, aur Khuda tumhaare dilon ke haal ko aazmaana chaahta hai aur tumhaare zameer ki haqeeqat ko waazeh karna chaahta hai, aur woh khud har dil ka haal jaanta hai

Jin logon ne donon lashkaron ke takraao ke din peeth pher li yeh wahi hain jinhein Shaitaan ne un ke kiye dhare ki bina par behka diya hai, aur Khuda ne un ko maaf kar diya ke woh Ghafoor aur Haleem hai

Ae imaan waalo! Khabardaar kaafiron jaise na ho jaao jinhon ne apne saathiyon ke safar ya jang mein marne par yeh kehna shuroo kar diya ke woh hamaare paas hote to na marte aur na qatl kiye jaate. Khuda tumhaari alaahidgi hi ko un ke liye baa'is-e-masarrat (khushi ka sabab) qaraar dena chaahta hai, ke maut o hayaat usi ke ikhtiyaar mein hai aur woh tumhaare aamaal se khoob baakhabar hai
Agar tum raah-e-Khuda mein mar gaye ya qatl ho gaye to Khuda ki taraf se maghfirat aur rehmat un cheezon se kaheen ziyaada behtar hai jinhein yeh jama kar rahe hain
Aur tum apni maut se maro ya qatl ho jaao, sab Allah hi ki baargaah mein haazir kiye jaaoge

Paighambar! Yeh Allah ki meharbaani hai ke tum un logon ke liye narm ho, warna agar tum bad-mizaaj aur sakht-dil hote to yeh tumhaare paas se bhaag khade hote. Lihaaza ab inhein maaf kar do, un ke liye istighfaar karo aur un se amr-e-jang mein mashwara karo, aur jab iraada kar lo to Allah par bharosa karo ke woh bharosa karne waalon ko dost rakhta hai
Allah tumhaari madad karega to koi tum par ghaalib nahin aa sakta, aur woh tumhein chhod dega to us ke baad kaun madad karega? Aur saahibaan-e-imaan to Allah hi par bharosa karte hain

Kisi nabi ke liye yeh mumkin nahin hai ke woh khiyaanat kare, aur jo khiyaanat karega woh roz-e-qiyaamat khiyaanat ke maal samet haazir hoga, us ke baad har nafs ko us ke kiye ka poora poora badla diya jaaega aur kisi par koi zulm nahin kiya jaaega
Kya razaa-e-Ilaahi ka ittibaa' karne waala us ke jaisa hoga jo ghazab-e-Ilaahi mein giraftaar ho, ke us ka anjaam Jahannam hai aur woh badtareen manzil hai
Sab ke pesh-e-Parwardigar darajaat hain, aur Khuda sab ke aamaal se baakhabar hai

Yaqeenan Khuda ne saahibaan-e-imaan par ehsaan kiya hai ke un ke darmiyaan unhi mein se ek Rasool bheja hai jo un par aayaat-e-Ilaahiya ki tilaawat karta hai, inhein paakeeza banaata hai aur kitaab o hikmat ki ta'leem deta hai, agarche yeh log pehle se badi khuli gumraahi mein mubtala the

Kya jab tum par woh museebat padi jis ki dugni tum kuffaar par daal chuke the to tum ne yeh kehna shuroo kar diya ke yeh kaise ho gaya? To Paighambar! Aap keh dijiye ke yeh sab khud tumhaari taraf se hai, aur Allah har shai par qaadir hai
Aur jo kuch bhi Islam o kufr ke lashkar ke muqaable ke din tum logon ko takleef pahunchi hai woh Khuda ke ilm mein hai, aur isi liye ke woh momineen ko jaanna chaahta tha

Aur munaafiqeen ko bhi dekhna chaahta tha. Un munaafiqeen se kaha gaya ke aao raah-e-Khuda mein jihaad karo ya apne nafs se difaa' karo, to unhon ne kaha ke hum ko maaloom hota ke waaqe'i jang hogi to tumhaare saath zaroor aate. Yeh imaan ki nisbat kufr se ziyaada qareeb-tar hain, aur zabaan se woh kehte hain jo dil mein nahin hota, aur Allah un ke posheeda umoor se baakhabar hai

Yahi woh log hain jinhon ne apne maqtool bhaaiyon ke baare mein yeh kehna shuroo kar diya ke woh hamaari itaa'at karte to hargiz qatl na hote. To Paighambar! Un se keh dijiye ke agar apne da'we mein sachche ho to ab apni hi maut ko taal do
Aur khabardaar raah-e-Khuda mein qatl hone waalon ko murda khayaal na karna, woh zinda hain aur apne Parwardigar ke yahaan rizq pa rahe hain

Khuda ki taraf se milne waale fazl o karam se khush hain, aur jo abhi tak un se mulhaq nahin ho sake hain un ke baare mein yeh khush-khabri rakhte hain ke un ke waaste bhi na koi khauf hai aur na huzn
Woh apne Parwardigar ki ne'mat, us ke fazl aur us ke wa'de se khush hain ke woh saahibaan-e-imaan ke ajr ko zaaya nahin karta
Yeh saahibaan-e-imaan hain jinhon ne zakhmi hone ke baad bhi Khuda aur Rasool ki daawat par labbaik kahi. Un ke nek-kirdaar aur muttaqi afraad ke liye nihaayat darja ajr-e-azeem hai

Yeh woh imaan waale hain ke jab un se ba'z logon ne kaha ke logon ne tumhaare liye azeem lashkar jama kar liya hai lihaaza un se daro, to un ke imaan mein aur izaafa ho gaya aur unhon ne kaha ke hamaare liye Khuda kaafi hai aur wahi hamaara zimmedaar hai
Pas yeh mujaahideen Khuda ke fazl o karam se yun palat aaye ke inhein koi takleef nahin pahunchi, aur unhon ne razaa-e-Ilaahi ka ittibaa' kiya, aur Allah saahib-e-fazl-e-azeem hai
Yeh Shaitaan sirf apne chaahne waalon ko daraata hai, lihaaza tum un se na daro, aur agar momin ho to mujh se daro

Aur aap kufr mein tezi karne waalon ki taraf se ranjeeda na hon, yeh Khuda ka koi nuqsaan nahin kar sakte. Khuda chaahta hai ke un ka aakhirat mein koi hissa na reh jaaye aur sirf azaab-e-azeem reh jaaye
Jin logon ne imaan ke badle kufr khareed liya hai woh Khuda ko koi nuqsaan nahin pahuncha sakte, aur un ke liye dardnaak azaab hai

Aur khabardaar yeh kuffaar yeh na samjhein ke hum jis qadr raahat o aaraam de rahe hain woh un ke haq mein koi bhalaai hai. Hum to sirf is liye de rahe hain ke jitna gunaah kar sakein kar lein, warna un ke liye ruswa-kun azaab hai

Khuda saahibaan-e-imaan ko unhi haalaat mein nahin chhod sakta jab tak khabees aur tayyib ko alag alag na kar de, aur woh tum ko ghaib par mutta'la bhi nahin karna chaahta, haan apne numaaindon mein se kuch logon ko is kaam ke liye muntakhab kar leta hai. Lihaaza tum Khuda aur Rasool par imaan rakho, aur agar imaan o taqwa ikhtiyaar karoge to tumhaare liye ajr-e-azeem hai

Aur khabardaar jo log Khuda ke diye hue mein bukhl karte hain un ke baare mein yeh na sochna ke is bukhl mein kuch bhalaai hai. Yeh bahut bura hai, aur anqareeb jis maal mein bukhl kiya hai woh roz-e-qiyaamat un ki gardan mein tauq bana diya jaaega, aur Allah hi ke liye zameen o aasmaan ki milkiyat hai, aur woh tumhaare aamaal se khoob baakhabar hai

Allah ne un ki baat ko bhi sun liya hai jin ka kehna hai ke Khuda faqeer hai aur hum maaldaar hain. Hum un ki is muhmal baat ko aur un ke ambiya ke naahaq qatl karne ko likh rahe hain, aur anjaam-e-kaar un se kahenge ke ab Jahannam ka maza chakho
Is liye ke tum ne pehle hi is ke asbaab faraaham kar liye hain, aur Khuda apne bandon par zulm nahin karta hai

Jo log yeh kehte hain ke Allah ne hum se ahd liya hai ke hum us waqt tak kisi rasool par imaan na laayein jab tak woh aisi qurbaani pesh na kare jise aasmaani aag kha jaaye, to un se keh dijiye ke mujh se pehle bahut se rasool mo'jizaat aur tumhaari farmaaish ke mutaabiq sadaaqat ki nishaani le aaye, phir tum ne inhein kyon qatl kar diya agar tum apni baat mein sachche ho
Us ke baad bhi aap ki takzeeb karein to aap se pehle bhi rasoolon ki takzeeb ho chuki hai jo mo'jizaat, mawaa'iz aur raushan kitaab sab kuch le kar aaye the

Har nafs maut ka maza chakhne waala hai, aur tumhaara mukammal badla to sirf qiyaamat ke din milega. Us waqt jise Jahannam se bacha liya gaya aur jannat mein daakhil kar diya gaya woh kaamyaab hai, aur zindagaani-e-duniya to sirf dhoke ka sarmaaya hai

Yaqeenan tum apne amwaal aur nufoos ke zariye aazmaaye jaaoge, aur jin ko tum se pehle kitaab di gayi hai aur jo mushrik ho gaye hain sab ki taraf se bahut aziyyat-naak baatein sunoge. Ab agar tum sabr karoge aur taqwa ikhtiyaar karoge to yahi umoor mein istehkaam ka sabab hai

Us mauqe ko yaad karo jab Khuda ne jin ko kitaab di un se ahd liya ke use logon ke liye bayaan karenge aur use chhupaayenge nahin, lekin unhon ne us ahd ko pas-e-pusht daal diya aur thodi qeemat par bech diya, to yeh bahut bura sauda kiya hai

Khabardaar jo log apne kiye par maghroor hain aur chaahte hain ke jo achchhe kaam nahin kiye hain un par bhi un ki ta'reef ki jaaye, to khabardaar inhein azaab se mahfooz khayaal bhi na karna, un ke liye dardnaak azaab hai
Aur Allah ke liye zameen o aasmaan ki kul hukoomat hai aur woh har shai par qaadir hai
Beshak zameen o aasmaan ki khilqat, lail o nahaar ki aamad-o-raft mein saahibaan-e-aql ke liye qudrat ki nishaaniyaan hain

Jo log uthte, baithte, lette Khuda ko yaad karte hain aur aasmaan o zameen ki takhleeq mein ghaur o fikr karte hain ke Khudaya! Tu ne yeh sab bekaar nahin paida kiya hai, tu paak o be-niyaaz hai, humein azaab-e-Jahannam se mahfooz farma
Parwardigar! Tu jise Jahannam mein daal dega goya use zaleel o ruswa kar diya, aur zaalimeen ka koi madadgaar nahin hai

Parwardigar! Hum ne us munaadi ko suna jo imaan ki aawaaz laga raha tha ke apne Parwardigar par imaan le aao, to hum imaan le aaye. Parwardigar! Ab hamaare gunaahon ko maaf farma aur hamaari buraaiyon ki parda-poshi farma aur humein nek bandon ke saath mahshoor farma
Parwardigar! Jo tu ne apne rasoolon se wa'da kiya hai use ata farma aur roz-e-qiyaamat humein ruswa na karna, ke tu wa'de ke khilaaf nahin karta

Pas Khuda ne un ki dua ko qubool kiya ke main tum mein se kisi bhi amal karne waale ke amal ko zaaya nahin karoonga, chaahe woh mard ho ya aurat, tum mein ba'z ba'z se hain. Pas jin logon ne hijrat ki aur apne watan se nikaale gaye aur meri raah mein sataaye gaye aur unhon ne jihaad kiya aur qatl ho gaye, to main un ki buraaiyon ki parda-poshi karoonga aur inhein un jannaton mein daakhil karoonga jin ke neeche nahrein jaari hongi. Yeh Khuda ki taraf se sawaab hai, aur us ke paas behtareen sawaab hai
Khabardaar tumhein kuffaar ka shehar shehar chakkar lagaana dhoke mein na daal de
Yeh haqeer sarmaaya aur saamaan-e-ta'ayyush hai, us ke baad anjaam Jahannam hai aur woh badtareen manzil hai

Lekin jin logon ne taqwa-e-Ilaahi ikhtiyaar kiya un ke liye woh baaghaat hain jin ke neeche nahrein jaari hongi. Khuda ki taraf se yeh saamaan-e-ziyaafat hai, aur jo kuch us ke paas hai sab nek afraad ke liye khair hi khair hai

Ahl-e-kitaab mein woh log bhi hain jo Allah par aur jo kuch tumhaari taraf naazil hua hai aur jo un ki taraf naazil hua hai sab par imaan rakhte hain, Allah ke saamne sar jhukaaye hue hain, aayaat-e-Khuda haqeer si qeemat par farokht nahin karte. Un ke liye Parwardigar ke yahaan un ka ajr hai, aur Khuda bahut jald hisaab karne waala hai
Ae imaan waalo! Sabr karo, sabr ki ta'leem do, jihaad ke liye taiyaari karo aur Allah se daro shaayad tum falaah-yaafta aur kaamyaab ho jaao
